The surrounding section [ev-2e2ab2d37845] [ev-875bb56564b0] lists more renames of the same kind and also says nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. setting-ignored does not fit: a metric Cilium emits is not a configured value Cilium stops honouring, and the claim that alerts and collection fail goes beyond the evidence. correction.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the LB-IPAM metric lbipam_ips_used_total is renamed to lbipam_ips_used. Cilium still reports it, but under the new name; anything that queries the old name should be reviewed.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, Cilium reports the metric as lbipam_ips_used instead of lbipam_ips_used_total. The upgrade notes list this under Changed Metrics and do not say that anything fails or is rejected.
consequence.remediation: Check dashboards, recording rules and alerts that reference lbipam_ips_used_total, and update them to lbipam_ips_used where needed.
